"""Validate audit answers produced by main.py independently."""
import re
import json

def val_audit(req, out, sim_max=2000):
    P,R,D = len(req["inputs"]), None, None
    # recompute expected
    inp=req["inputs"]; P=len(inp); R=len(inp[0]) if P else 0
    D=len(inp[0][0]) if R else 0
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=inp[r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    states=req["states"]; n=len(states)
    edges=[tuple(e) for e in req["edges"]]; start=req["start"]
    fair=[(f["action"], f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]]
    def is_safe(st):
        for r in range(P):
            for q,v in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
                if v!=exp[q]: return False
        for sl in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in sl["ranks"]:
                v=inp[r][sl["seq"]]
                for i in range(D): tot[i]+=v[i]
            if sl["sum"]!=tot: return False
        return True
    def is_done(st):
        return all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
    enb=[set() for _ in range(n)]
    for (s,lab,t) in edges: enb[s].add(lab)
    # adjacency (all edges)
    adj={}
    for eid,(s,lab,t) in enumerate(edges): adj.setdefault(s,[]).append((eid,t))
    # --- safety witness
    if out["safe"] and out["safety"] is not None: return "safe=true but safety given"
    if (not out["safe"]) and out["safety"] is None: return "safe=false but no witness"
    if out["safety"] is not None:
        seq=out["safety"]["prefix"]
        cur=start; visited=[cur]
        for eid in seq:
            if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad safety edge id"
            s,lab,t=edges[eid]
            if s!=cur: return "safety edge does not start at current"
            cur=t; visited.append(cur)
        if not (0<=cur<n) or is_safe(states[cur]):
            return "safety prefix ends at safe state"
    # --- liveness witness
    if out["terminates"] and out["liveness"] is not None: return "terminates but witness"
    if (not out["terminates"]) and out["liveness"] is None: return "not terminates but no witness"
    if out["liveness"] is not None:
        pre=out["liveness"]["prefix"]; loop=out["liveness"]["loop"]
        if not loop: return "empty loop"
        cur=start
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                pass
            else:
                if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad prefix edge id"
                s,lab,t=edges[eid]
                if s!=cur: return "prefix edge mismatch"
                cur=t
        states_seen={cur}
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                states_seen.add(cur)
            else:
                seen2 = edges[eid][2]
                if edges[eid][0]!=cur: return "mismatch"
                cur=seen2; states_seen.add(cur)
                if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix visits done state"
        if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix end is done"
        loopstates=set()
        curs2=cur
        for eid in loop:
            if eid==-1:
                loopstates.add(cur); continue
            if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad loop edge id"
            s,lab,t=edges[eid]
            if s!=cur: return "loop edge mismatch at %d"%eid
            cur=t; loopstates.add(cur)
            if is_done(states[cur]): return "loop visits done state"
        if cur!=curs2: return "loop does not close"
        # fairness
        allst=states_seen | loopstates
        labels_used={(edges[e][1] if e!=-1 else None) for e in loop if e!=-1}
        for (a,mode) in fair:
            enabled_anywhere=any(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            used=a in labels_used
            every_enabled=all(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            if mode=="weak":
                if every_enabled and not used: return "WF %s violated"%a
            else:
                if enabled_anywhere and not used: return "SF %s violated"%a
    return None

def val_export(req, out):
    mod=out["module"]
    assert mod.startswith("---- MODULE ModelData ----")
    assert mod.rstrip().endswith("====")
    lines=[l for l in mod.split("\n") if l.strip()]
    header=lines[0]
    body=lines[1:-1]
    assert body[0]=="EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets"
    names_def=[]
    defs=[]
    for l in body[1:]:
        assert "==" in l, l
        k,v = l.split("==",1)
        names_def.append(k.strip())
        defs.append(v.strip())
    expect=["Nodes","Initial","Edges","ActionNames","WFIds","SFIds","SafeNodes","DoneNodes"]
    assert names_def==expect, names_def
    # Nodes
    m=re.fullmatch(r"0\.\.(\d+)", defs[0]); assert m
    nstates=len(req["states"]); assert int(m.group(1))==nstates-1
    # Initial
    assert defs[1]==str(req["start"])
    # edges set
    m=re.fullmatch(r"\{(.*)\}", defs[2]) if defs[2].startswith("{") else None
    inner=defs[2][1:-1] if defs[2].startswith("{") else defs[2]
    trip=[]
    if defs[2]:
        # parse <<a, b, c>> entries
        for mt in re.finditer(r"<<\s*(-?\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d+)\s*>>", defs[2]):
            trip.append(tuple(int(x) for x in mt.groups()))
    # check parse consumed all
    residue = re.sub(r"<<\s*-?\d+\s*,\s*-?\d+\s*,\s*-?\d+\s*>>","",defs[2] if defs[2] else "")
    residue = residue.strip().strip("{}").strip()
    assert residue=="" , repr(residue)
    edges=[tuple(e) for e in req["edges"]]
    # names
    m=re.fullmatch(r"<<(.*?)>>", defs[3])
    names=re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', defs[3]) if m.group(1).strip() else []
    assert names==sorted(set(names)) or True
    allnames=set()
    for e in edges: allnames.add(e[1])
    for f in req["fairness"]: allnames.add(f["action"])
    assert set(names)==allnames, (names, allnames)
    assert names==sorted(allnames)
    aidx={a:i+1 for i,a in enumerate(names)}
    assert len(trip)==len(edges)
    for t,(s,lab,tg) in zip(trip, edges):
        assert t[0]==s and t[1]==aidx[lab] and t[2]==tg, (t,(s,lab,tg))
    # WF / SF
    def parse_set(txt):
        m=re.fullmatch(r"\{(.*?)\}", txt)
        if not m: return None
        digits=[]
        if m.group(1).strip():
            for tok in re.finditer(r"(-?\d+)", m.group(1)): digits.append(tok.group(1))
        residue=re.sub(r"(-?\d+)","",m.group(1)).strip()
        assert residue=="", repr(residue)
        return set(int(x) for x in digits)
    wf=parse_set(defs[4]); sf=parse_set(defs[5])
    expwf={aidx[a] for a,m2 in [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]] if m2=="weak"}
    expsf={aidx[a] for a,m2 in [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in req["fairness"]] if m2=="strong"}
    assert wf==expwf, (wf,expwf)
    assert sf==expsf, (sf,expsf)
    safe=parse_set(defs[6]); done=parse_set(defs[7])
    P=len(req["inputs"]); R=len(req["inputs"][0]) if P else 0; D=len(req["inputs"][0][0]) if R else 0
    exp=[]
    for q in range(R):
        s=[0]*D
        for r in range(P):
            v=req["inputs"][r][q]
            for i in range(D): s[i]+=v[i]
        exp.append(s)
    for i,st in enumerate(req["states"]):
        safeok=True
        for r in range(P):
            for qq,v in enumerate(st["delivered"][r]):
                if v!=exp[qq]: safeok=False
        for sl in st["slots"]:
            tot=[0]*D
            for r in sl["ranks"]:
                v=req["inputs"][r][sl["seq"]]
                for j in range(D): tot[j]+=v[j]
            if sl["sum"]!=tot: safeok=False
        assert safeok==(i in safe), ("safenode",i)
        isdone=all(len(st["delivered"][r])==R for r in range(P))
        assert isdone==(i in done), ("donenode",i)
    cfg=out["config"]
    toks=cfg.split()
    assert toks==["SPECIFICATION","Spec","INVARIANT","Safety","PROPERTY","Termination","CHECK_DEADLOCK","FALSE"], toks
    return None
